International Student Desk
EU citizens who plan to stay less than 1 year (e.g., Exchange/Erasmus students), have the possibility to access the Temporary Residence Registration . The Declaration of temporary residence does not transfer / affect your residence status.
In collaboration with the City Registry of Milano, we decided to make this registration process easy and streamlined. Here is how you can proceed.

Application
To apply you will have to fill out a two-page form:
- The first one contains your personal data and application for temporary residence.
- The second one is a self-assessment that you have the means to sustain yourself, where they come from (e.g. personal assets, family assets, work income) and where they can be verified (e.g. name of your bank, name of your employer...).
You can download the form below, fill it in, sign it and submit it by e-mail to the City Registry Office ( DSC.AnagrafeVariazioni@comune.milano.it ) with attached:
- Scan of your EU ID or Passport (pdf)
- Scan of your Tax Code certificate or card (pdf)
- Scan of a statement of University/Academy enrolment (pdf)
- Proof of health coverage: copy of your EHIC European health insurance card, or of S1 form, or Italian Tessera Sanitaria or private insurance certificate (pdf)
Send the form and the attachments to the City Registry Office ( DSC.AnagrafeVariazioni@comune.milano.it ).
After a couple of weeks, you will receive a confirmation e-mail with a protocol number as a receipt.
The registration is valid for one year .
